Owner Notification Letter - As stated in the initial noticed, the fuel pump module may have an improperly molded impeller. Over time the impeller can deform and cause the fuel pump to become inoperable.

Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive
power, or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

This notice is sent to you in accordance with the National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act. Honda has decided that a defect which relates to motor vehicle safety exists in certain 2016-2021 Pilot vehicles. In February 2024, a notice was mailed to inform you about this defect and that replacement parts needed to perform the repair were in limited availability. This notice is being sent to inform you that these parts are now available and you can bring your vehicle in for a free repair.

On December 18, 2023, Acura notified NHTSA of its intention to initiate a stop sale and safety recall for a certain number of 2018-2020 ILX, 2018-2020 MDX, 2018-2020 MDX Hybrid, 2017-2020 NSX, 2018-2020 RDX, 2018-2020 RLX, and 2018-2020 TLX units. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Affected vehicles may be equipped with seat weight sensors not built to proper specifications. Improperly built sensors could lead to cracking and/or a short circuit of the sensor resulting in the illumination of the SRS warning indicator. In certain collisions, these seat weight sensors may cause improper deployment of the front passenger airbag, increasing the risk of injury.

An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive power or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

This notice is sent to you in accordance with the National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act. Honda has decided that a defect which relates to motor vehicle safety exists in certain 2016-2021 Pilot vehicles. In February 2024, a notice was mailed to inform you about this defect and that replacement parts needed to perform the repair were in limited availability. This notice is being sent to inform you that these parts are now available and you can bring your vehicle in for a free repair.

On December 18, 2023, Acura notified NHTSA of its intention to initiate a stop sale and safety recall for a certain number of 2018-2020 ILX, 2018-2020 MDX, 2018-2020 MDX Hybrid, 2017-2020 NSX, 2018-2020 RDX, 2018-2020 RLX, and 2018-2020 TLX units. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

repair done.

An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive power or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

On December 18, 2023, Acura notified NHTSA of its intention to initiate a stop sale and safety recall for a certain number of 2018-2020 ILX, 2018-2020 MDX, 2018-2020 MDX Hybrid, 2017-2020 NSX, 2018-2020 RDX, 2018-2020 RLX, and 2018-2020 TLX units. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

repair done.

Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive power or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

On December 18, 2023, Acura notified NHTSA of its intention to initiate a stop sale and safety recall for a certain number of 2018-2020 ILX, 2018-2020 MDX, 2018-2020 MDX Hybrid, 2017-2020 NSX, 2018-2020 RDX, 2018-2020 RLX, and 2018-2020 TLX units. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive
power, or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

Owner Notification Letter - As stated in the initial noticed, the fuel pump module may have an improperly molded impeller. Over time the impeller can deform and cause the fuel pump to become inoperable.

Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive
power, or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

This limitation may cause a loss of motive power or a stall while being driven, increasing the risk of a crash or injury, creating a safety hazard.

Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive power or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Affected vehicles may be equipped with seat weight sensors not built to proper specifications. Improperly built sensors could lead to cracking and/or a short circuit of the sensor resulting in the illumination of the SRS warning indicator. In certain collisions, these seat weight sensors may cause improper deployment of the front passenger airbag, increasing the risk of injury.

An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive power or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

This notice is sent to you in accordance with the National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act. Honda has decided that a defect which relates to motor vehicle safety exists in certain 2016-2021 Pilot vehicles. In February 2024, a notice was mailed to inform you about this defect and that replacement parts needed to perform the repair were in limited availability. This notice is being sent to inform you that these parts are now available and you can bring your vehicle in for a free repair.

Owner Notification Letter - As stated in the initial noticed, the fuel pump module may have an improperly molded impeller. Over time the impeller can deform and cause the fuel pump to become inoperable.

Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive
power, or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or

An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive
power, or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

On December 18, 2023, Acura notified NHTSA of its intention to initiate a stop sale and safety recall for a certain number of 2018-2020 ILX, 2018-2020 MDX, 2018-2020 MDX Hybrid, 2017-2020 NSX, 2018-2020 RDX, 2018-2020 RLX, and 2018-2020 TLX units. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Owner Notification Letter - As stated in the initial notice, the fuel pump module may have an improperly molded impeller. Over time the impeller can deform and cause the fuel pump to become inoperable.
Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive power or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

On December 18, 2023, Acura notified NHTSA of its intention to initiate a stop sale and safety recall for a certain number of 2018-2020 ILX, 2018-2020 MDX, 2018-2020 MDX Hybrid, 2017-2020 NSX, 2018-2020 RDX, 2018-2020 RLX, and 2018-2020 TLX units. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

On December 18, 2023, American Honda notified NHTSA of its intention to initiate a stop sale and safety recall for a certain number of 2018-2020 Accord, 2017 Accord Hybrid, 2018-2020 Civic, 2018-2020 Civic Type-R, 2018-2019 Clarity, 2018-2020 CR-V, 2018-2019 Fit, 2018-2020 HR-V, 2019-2020 Insight, 2018-2020 Odyssey, 2019-2020 Passport, 2017-2020 Pilot, and 2018-2020 Ridgeline units. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. A defective impeller may cause the fuel pump to become inoperative which could prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash.

In certain collisions, these seat weight sensors may cause improper deployment of the front passenger airbag, increasing the risk of injury.

An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive power or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or

repair done.

Owner Notification Letter - As stated in the initial noticed, the fuel pump module may have an improperly molded impeller. Over time the impeller can deform and cause the fuel pump to become inoperable.

Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive
power, or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive
power, or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

repair done.

Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive
power, or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

On December 18, 2023, Acura notified NHTSA of its intention to initiate a stop sale and safety recall for a certain number of 2018-2020 ILX, 2018-2020 MDX, 2018-2020 MDX Hybrid, 2017-2020 NSX, 2018-2020 RDX, 2018-2020 RLX, and 2018-2020 TLX units. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or

repair done.

In February 2024, a notice was mailed to inform you about this defect and that replacement parts needed to perform the repair were in limited availability. This notice is being sent to inform you that these parts are now available and you can bring your vehicle in for a free repair.

Owner Notification Letter - As stated in the initial notice, the fuel pump module may have an improperly molded impeller. Over time the impeller can deform and cause the fuel pump to become inoperable.
Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive power or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

On December 18, 2023, Acura notified NHTSA of its intention to initiate a stop sale and safety recall for a certain number of 2018-2020 ILX, 2018-2020 MDX, 2018-2020 MDX Hybrid, 2017-2020 NSX, 2018-2020 RDX, 2018-2020 RLX, and 2018-2020 TLX units. Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Affected vehicles may be equipped with seat weight sensors not built to proper specifications. Improperly built sensors could lead to cracking and/or a short circuit of the sensor resulting in the illumination of the SRS warning indicator. In certain collisions, these seat weight sensors may cause improper deployment of the front passenger airbag, increasing the risk of injury.

repair done.

Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive power or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive

The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

repair done.

Owner Notification Letter - As stated in the initial noticed, the fuel pump module may have an improperly molded impeller. Over time the impeller can deform and cause the fuel pump to become inoperable.

Safety Consequence
An inoperable fuel pump could prevent an engine from starting, cause a vehicle to lose drive
power, or stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Emission Consequence
The check engine light may illuminate as a result of this defect. Your vehicle may fail a state or
local emissions inspection when such tests are required under state law if you do not have the
repair done.

repair done.

If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, the fuel pump can become inoperative. An inoperative fuel pump could cause the Malfunction Indicator Lamp in the instrument panel to illuminate, and/or prevent the engine from starting or stall the engine while driving, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

Affected vehicles above may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers. The low density impellers may absorb fuel over time and deform. If an impeller deforms to a point that it creates sufficient interference with the fuel pump body, and the fuel pump can become inoperative. This limitation may cause a loss of motive power or a stall while being driven, increasing the risk of a crash or injury, creating a safety hazard.

TSB 12-23-8 describes issue for generators with electrical brake and battery disconnect options installed and listed on bulletin 12-23-8.  It has been identified that the electric brake harness connection may be connected to the positive distribution lug of the battery disconnect switch instead of the positive battery cable terminal. If connected in this manner and the battery disconnect switch is in the off position, the emergency electric brakes will be deenergized.

Instructions for the dealer to remedy the issue are provided as well as how to file warranty claim for reimbursement of costs associated with the repair of this issue.

Nova Bus (US) Inc. has decided that a defect which relates to motor vehicle safety exists in certain Nova Bus model LFS and model year 2023 manufactured from June 2023 equipped with the attachment plate to attach the front air spring.

The affected vehicles may have the front air spring hardware attachment points that may fail due to an improper attachment plate. The air spring hardware may dislodge from the attachment plate which in turn may result in the sudden loss of suspension resulting in an increased risk of crash.

The service document CR5537 explaining the measures to be taken to remedy the affected vehicles will be published on Nova Bus web site. The vehicles can be remedied starting from February 12th 2024. The remedy, will be to remove the attachment plate and replace it with an attachment plate that meets the mechanical and material properties specified for the component, should take approximately 3 hours to complete.

The affected vehicles may have the front air spring hardware attachment points that may fail due to an improper anchor plate. The air spring hardware may dislodge from the anchor plate which in turn may result in the sudden loss of suspension resulting in an increased risk of a crash.

Personally Identifiable Information (PII) : The information regarding for the complete VIN (vehicle identification number) has been highlighted in black to preserved the confidentiality for the customer.
